description: s.206CC (NOT s.206AA): where the collectee furnishes no PAN, tax is collected at the HIGHER of twice the rate in force and 5%. Scrap rate is 1%; max(2 x 1%, 5%) = 5%. 5,00,000 x 5% = 25,000. Hand-computed. Note this is 5%, NOT the 20% that s.206AA would impose on the deduction side — the two no-PAN regimes are different and must not be collapsed.
